headline_pain: Your Rent Just Went Up. Again.
headline_outcome: Lock In a Fixed Warehouse Price
primary_text: "I'm paying more in rent every year and getting nothing to show for it. Dead money." We hear this every week from business owners in the west. The maths is simple: if your rent is $35k+ a year and climbing, in five years you've handed over $200k with zero to show. Our new off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina offer a way out. Buy at today's price, settle on completion, and turn that dead money into a real asset. 20km from Melbourne CBD, right near the Princes Freeway. Purpose-built for small business owner-occupiers.
description: Buy at today's price and stop losing $35k+ per year to rising rent.
